summary: Keep paused threads visibly open, with their pause notice under their own heading and one plain explanation per view

replay.detail: Rendering only; no durable data is replayed.

schema.detail: No wire or storage schema changes. The paused status keeps its existing update shape with plainer text.

rules.detail: The four-thread live-window budget and its pause/resume policy are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Clients and daemons interoperate as before.

manual.detail: Expand more threads than the live budget admits. Each paused thread shows ▾ with 'Paused · collapse a thread to resume live updates' directly under its heading, and the view explains the pause once below its threads. Clicking ▾ collapses it to ▸.

recovery.detail: No state changes; collapse a thread or close another view to resume live updates.
